title: permission.denied keeps any short bracketed text of the denial reason as its rule
goal: ql_capture's permission.denied row names a rule only from a closed list of the auto-mode classifier's documented rule names (else no rule), as turn.error does with STOP_ERRORS, so no free text of a denial reason reaches an ops row; a planted reason with a host and a name in brackets stores no rule. Found by the SP-smqwmchu review.

run: import sys,re;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import ql_capture as q;m=q.DENIED_RULE.search('[PL-LT-00123 jan kowalski]');sys.exit(1 if m else 0)
